name: find-docs
description: Retrieve current documentation, API references, and code examples for any library, framework, SDK, CLI tool, or cloud service — including well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Django, or Spring Boot. Use for API syntax, configuration options, version migrations, setup instructions, and library-specific debugging, even when you already think you know the answer: training data on API details and signatures is frequently outdated. Prefer this over web search for library documentation.
